services.desc: Enjoy the beautiful morning breezes and the sights and sounds of Hyannis Harbor while practicing a slow, meditative yoga flow designed for all ages, bodies and levels. Join us for a 60 minute “Yoga Cruise”. Enjoy the beautiful morning breezes and the sights and sounds of Hyannis Harbor while practicing a slow, meditative yoga flow designed for all ages, bodies and levels. No Mat required. We will begin with seated poses on the Bay Spirit’s benches and move to the railings for our ‘supported’ standing postures.
